info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Pharmacy Prescriptions Insurances-v3-spec
info.description: The Pharmacy Prescriptions Insurance List API provides a comprehensive overview of insurance options associated with pharmacy prescriptions. This endpoint allows users to fetch detailed information about various insurance providers, enabling healthcare professionals and pharmacies to efficiently manage prescription claims and patient billing. Typical consumers include pharmacists, healthcare administrators, and insurance coordinators who require quick access to insurance data for accurate prescription processing. By leveraging this API, businesses can enhance their operational efficiency and improve patient care through streamlined insurance verification.

get.description: This endpoint allows developers to fetch insurance details associated with prescriptions. It provides the necessary data to ensure that prescriptions are processed accurately based on the patient's insurance coverage.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve insurance information related to prescriptions. It should contain the necessary data structure as defined in the schema.
